name: Inbound demand or claim intake record
summary: When a demand, claim or subpoena arrives, the company's lawyer gets one intake record the same day: who sent it, what it asks, every date it states, the facts and citations it relies on, related matters, where the records are, and a question on keeping them. It rates nothing and recommends nothing.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for legal preparation: copy and locate rather than characterise, count no date, check no authority, work only from the company's own lists, and address every output to a named lawyer who decides.

sources.contribution: Three ideas: reading the same fixed set of points from every incoming letter, including how and when it arrived and any marking on it; looking through the company's own matters, finished ones too, for the same party; and flagging the law a letter cites for the lawyer to verify rather than validating it. Also the prompt that keeping records belongs among the first steps.
